title: Korea, Rep. · executive (head of state)
dateText: 3 June 2025 (special snap election in the wake of the impeachment of former President YOON Suk-yeol)
system: president directly elected by simple-majority popular vote for a single 5-year term; prime minister appointed by president with consent of the National Assembly

summary.selection: president directly elected by simple-majority popular vote for a single 5-year term; prime minister appointed by president with consent of the National Assembly
summary.heldOn: 3 June 2025 (special snap election in the wake of the impeachment of former President YOON Suk-yeol)
summary.results: 2025: LEE Jae-myung elected president; LEE Jae-myung (DPK) 49.4%, KIM Moon-soo (PPP) 41.2%, LEE Jun-seok (New Reform Party) 8.3%; 2022: YOON Suk-yeol elected president; YOON Suk-yeol (PPP) 48.6%, LEE Jae-myung (DPK) 47.8%; other 3.6%
